chapters.title: Gate Log
chapters.body: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first opened and had never closed before then. At 10点 on that day, it first closed after opening.

chapters.title: Reopen Log
chapters.body: The 11点 harbor signal gate log leaves any reopening and its operator unrecorded.

chapters.title: Telegram Seal
chapters.body: At 11点 on the same day, Sera had not opened the sealed telegram and did not know its code.

chapters.title: Later Recipient
chapters.body: At 13点 Sera opened the telegram and learned its code, but the record does not identify who delivered it.
